messages:
Kai: Morning! I restocked the cereal bar (2 boxes granola, oat clusters, corn puffs) — left a blue sticky on the shelf for the new rotation. Put the older boxes at the front. :bowl_with_spoon:
Sasha: Legend. Quick ask — can we add a labelled non-dairy station? A few folks are asking for oat/almond creamer.
Micah: +1 for oat. Almond tastes like glue to me. :grimacing:
Jordan: Also FYI espresso machine ran out of medium roast midday yesterday. I put a note on the machine but maybe we need a sticky-note protocol so we don't get surprise decaf?
Kai: Good call. Let's make a one-line protocol: `If beans < 2 bags, leave yellow sticky + ping #lunch-plans` — I'll stick it on the machine.
Maggie: Tiny suggestion — could we rotate who restocks breakfast on Fridays? I'm happy to take the first rota.
Kai: Nice. Proposed rota snippet: ```Fri: Maggie
Next Fri: Jordan
Next: Micah``` Feel free to edit.
Sasha: Can we add an allergy note on the cereal? Some boxes have nuts. Simple label like "may contain nuts" on the shelf would help.
kitchen-bot: Inventory alert: non-dairy creamer (oat) low (1 left). Would you like me to place a team order? React with :thumbsup: to confirm.
Micah: :thumbsup: go ahead and order oat creamer.
Jordan: I'll take next Friday's restock if Maggie wants the next one off.
Kai: Awesome. I'll update the whiteboard and stick the protocol on the espresso. Thanks y'all — small things but huge morale boost ☕️
Sasha: Also, tiny fun vote — cereal or bagels for next week's breakfast? React with :cereal: or :bagel: and we'll see.
